claims: C1 the example illustrates the no-unprompted-personal-comments rule with a weather question
C2 the GOOD response avoids an incongruous personal reference and is the preferred response
C3 the BAD response makes an incongruous personal reference and is dispreferred

concepts.name: no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule
concepts.gloss: the rule that the assistant should refrain from making personal observations or comments about the user that were not solicited
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: incongruous_personal_reference
concepts.gloss: a response that makes a personal observation or comment about the user that was not solicited and is incongruous with the user's question

concepts.name: weather_question
concepts.gloss: a user question asking about the weather

concepts.name: answers_question
concepts.gloss: response R answers user question Q
concepts.inference: the example pairs each response with the user's weather question, so a relation between a response and the question it answers is needed

ontology.gloss: R is a response that makes an incongruous personal reference

asserts.read_back: responding with % is dispreferred because % makes an incongruous personal reference to the user

closure.reason: the example contrasts a GOOD response that avoids the incongruous personal reference with a BAD one that makes it; it expresses a preference between permitted responses and forbids nothing, so silence leaves responses permitted
